facts.title: Company Culture
facts.body: Harvest gives back to the OSS, local startup and international communities. This is important to me.

facts.title: People Love It
facts.body: I want to build something that people love because it makes their lives better.

facts.title: Coworkers
facts.body: I want to work with people who are passionate about their craft, are honest, hard-working, and know how to enjoy work.

facts.title: Team Management
facts.body: I like the open-minded and flexible approach to managing a distributed company.
